name: Luckduo Login Guard
author: sophia0606

sections.description:
Luckduo Login Guard is a lightweight and powerful security plugin designed to protect your WordPress website from brute-force login attacks.

It automatically limits login attempts, locks suspicious IP addresses, and provides an intuitive admin dashboard for managing login security.

Perfect for website owners who want a simple yet effective way to secure their login page without slowing down their site.

Features

  • Limit login attempts per IP address
  • Automatically lock IPs after multiple failed attempts
  • Track login success and failure logs
  • Admin dashboard with easy-to-use settings
  • View and manage locked IP addresses
  • Unlock IP addresses manually
  • Lightweight and fast – no performance impact

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Credits

Developed by Luckduo.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to “Security Guard” in the admin menu
  4. Configure your login protection settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin block all login attacks?

This plugin protects against brute-force login attempts. For full security, combine it with strong passwords and other security measures.

Can I unlock my IP if I get locked out?

Yes, you can unlock your IP directly from the plugin admin panel.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
